title: 第十章 蜜饯有味
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
谢无咎第二日一早便想回归墟峰。

    不是因为双生契松了。

    是因为槐荫坡太吵。

    天还没亮，铁柱在院子里数铜钱。

    一枚。

    两枚。

    三枚。

    数到第十七枚时，糖糕从屋檐跳下来，踩翻了钱盆。

    铁柱抬头：“你欠我十七枚。”

    糖糕叼着鱼干，含糊道：“本仙是替你检查钱有没有长脚。”

    阿青挂在槐树上笑。

    柳嬷嬷在灶房里剁馅，菜刀落案板的声音稳得像在斩煞。

    沈清萝蹲在井边洗脸，边洗边算今天要去梁家补查的符纸成本。

    谢无咎站在仓房门口，眉心隐隐作痛。

    归墟峰万煞齐啸，都没这院子烦人。

    柳嬷嬷端着早饭出来，看见他站着，立刻道：“少爷，吃饭。”

    “不吃。”

    “您昨晚也这么说，最后喝了两碗汤。”

    “无味。”

    柳嬷嬷把碗放到桌上。

    “无味也要吃。您现在同沈姑娘结着契，您若饿出问题，反噬到人家姑娘身上怎么办？”

    沈清萝立刻抬头：“会反噬？”

    谢无咎冷声：“不会。”

    宋砚从院外进来，手中拿着几张查来的卷宗：“古契残卷记载不全，但双方气血过弱时，契线确会不稳。”

    沈清萝看向谢无咎。

    谢无咎看向宋砚。

    宋砚低头：“属下只说卷宗。”

    沈清萝把碗推到谢无咎面前。

    “吃。”

    谢无咎冷笑：“你命令我？”

    “不是命令。“沈清萝认真道，“是降低我的意外损耗。”

    谢无咎：“……”

    柳嬷嬷笑着给沈清萝夹了一块葱油饼。

    “姑娘说得对。”

    谢无咎最终坐下。

    他吃东西很安静，一筷一勺，像在办一桩无趣的公事。汤也好，饼也好，进了嘴都是一个味——没味。

    说不上难吃，就是什么都尝不出来，跟嚼一口陈年的灰差不多。

    对他来说，吃饭从不算吃饭，不过是给这副盛着归墟煞气的躯壳添点柴火，免得它先垮了。

    这样有多少年，他没算过，反正记忆里那三百年，顿顿如此。

    沈清萝坐在对面，正把一小碟蜜饯护到自己身边。糖糕盯着那碟蜜饯，眼神炽烈。

    “阿萝，本仙今日守院有功。”

    “你今日踩翻了铁柱的钱盆。”

    “那是意外。”

    “还偷吃了小鱼干。”

    “那是柳嬷嬷孝敬本仙。”

    “还挠了谢无咎的门。”

    糖糕理直气壮：“本仙帮他测试门结不结实。”

    沈清萝夹起一颗蜜饯，放到糖糕面前。
content_en:
Xie Wujiu wanted to return to Xu Peak early the next morning.

    It’s not because the twin bond has been loosened.

    It's because Huaiyinpo is too noisy.

    Before dawn, Tie Zhu was counting coins in the yard.

    One piece.

    Two.

    Three pieces.

    When the seventeenth coin was counted, Tang Cake jumped down from the eaves and stepped on the money basin.

    Tie Zhu raised his head: "You owe me seventeen."

    Tanggai held the dried fish in his mouth and said vaguely: "I am here to check whether the money has legs for you."

    Ah Qing was hanging on the locust tree and laughing.

    Aunt Liu was chopping stuffing in the kitchen, and the sound of the kitchen knife hitting the chopping board was as steady as chopping evil.

    Shen Qingluo squatted by the well and washed her face. While washing, she calculated the cost of the talisman she had to go to Liang's house for re-examination today.

    Xie Wujiu stood at the door of the warehouse, his brows aching.

    All the evil spirits roaring at Guixu Peak are not as annoying as this courtyard.

    Aunt Liu came out with breakfast. When she saw him standing, she immediately said: "Master, eat."

    "Don't eat."

    "You said the same thing last night and ended up drinking two bowls of soup."

    "Tasteless."

    Aunt Liu put the bowl on the table.

    "You have to eat even if it's tasteless. You have formed a contract with Miss Shen now. What if something happens to you due to hunger and it backfires on this girl?"

    Shen Qingluo immediately raised her head: "Will it backfire?"

    Xie Wujiu said coldly: "No."

    Song Yan came in from outside the hospital, holding several files that he had found in his hand: "The remaining records of the ancient contract are incomplete, but when the energy and blood of both parties are too weak, the contract line will indeed be unstable."

    Shen Qingluo looked at Xie Wujiu.

    Xie Wujiu looked at Song Yan.

    Song Yan lowered his head: "I only talk about the files."

    Shen Qingluo pushed the bowl in front of Xie Wujiu.

    "Eat."

    Xie Wujiu sneered: "You order me?"

    "It's not an order." Shen Qingluo said seriously, "It's to reduce my unexpected losses."

    Xie Wujiu: "..."

    Aunt Liu smiled and gave Shen Qingluo a piece of scallion pancake.

    "The girl is right."

    Xie Wujiu finally sat down.

    He ate very quietly, taking chopsticks and spoons at a time, as if he were doing some boring business. Whether it's soup or pancakes, they all taste the same when they enter your mouth - tasteless.

    I couldn't say it was unpalatable, but I couldn't taste anything. It was almost like chewing a mouthful of old ash.

    For him, eating is never considered eating, it is just adding some firewood to this body that contains the evil spirit of Guixu, lest it collapse first.

    He hadn't counted how many years it had been like this, but anyway, it was like this in his memory during the three hundred years.

    Shen Qingluo was sitting opposite, holding a small plate of preserves to her side. Tang Cake stared at the plate of preserves with intense eyes.

    "A Luo, I have done a good job guarding the courtyard today."

    "You stepped on the iron pillar and overturned the money basin today."

    "That was an accident."

    "I even ate dried fish secretly."

    "That's Aunt Liu's filial piety to me."

    "He even scratched Xie Wujiu's door."

    Tang Cake said confidently: "I will help him test whether the door knot is strong."

    Shen Qingluo picked up a candied fruit and placed it in front of the candy cake.
